title: Wayfare Pro Programme Terms, Schedule A: Status Levels and Entry Gates
content:
Every driver's earnings account under **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro** carries one Wayfare Pro status for the current quarter. The six statuses, from the first level to the sixth, are Wayfare Pro Blue, Wayfare Pro Silver, Wayfare Pro Gold, Wayfare Pro Platinum, Wayfare Pro Diamond and Wayfare Pro Diamond Elite. Each status has an entry gate made of four measures taken over the qualifying quarter: the Pro points earned in that quarter, the driver's rating, the driver's cancellation rate and the driver's acceptance rate.

## A.1 Entry gates

| Level | Status | Pro points in the quarter (at least) | Rating (at least) | Cancellation rate (at most) | Acceptance rate (at least) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Wayfare Pro Blue | 0 | 0.00 | 100.00% | 0% |
| 2 | Wayfare Pro Silver | 250 | 4.70 | 10.00% | 0% |
| 3 | Wayfare Pro Gold | 600 | 4.80 | 8.00% | 80% |
| 4 | Wayfare Pro Platinum | 1200 | 4.85 | 6.00% | 85% |
| 5 | Wayfare Pro Diamond | 2400 | 4.85 | 5.00% | 85% |
| 6 | Wayfare Pro Diamond Elite | 4000 | 4.90 | 4.00% | 90% |

A gate is met only when all four of its measures are met together. The Wayfare Pro Blue gate is met by every driver.

## A.2 Qualifying period and evaluation terms

The following terms are the same at every status (Blue, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond and Diamond Elite):

| Term | Value at every status |
|---|---|
| Length of a qualifying period | 3 months: one calendar quarter (January to March, April to June, July to September, October to December) |
| Basis of a quarter's status | The points and quality measures of the calendar quarter just ended (the prior calendar quarter) |
| Most levels a driver can drop at one quarterly evaluation (status protection) | 1 level |
| Pro points at quarter end | Reset to 0 at the end of each quarter, after the evaluation |

## A.3 Reading the schedule

**Which gate counts?** The status that results from a quarter is the highest one whose four measures are all met, subject to the status protection term above.

**Hypothetical illustration (not a driver's record).** A quarter closing with 700 Pro points, a rating of 4.82, a cancellation rate of 7.50% and an acceptance rate of 82% meets the Gold gate (600 points, 4.80, at most 8.00%, at least 80%) and fails the Platinum gate on points (1200 needed), on rating (4.85 needed) and on acceptance (85% needed). The highest gate met is Wayfare Pro Gold.

**Hypothetical illustration of status protection.** A driver holding Wayfare Pro Diamond whose quarter meets only the Silver gate drops by no more than 1 level at that evaluation, to Wayfare Pro Platinum.

**Do points build up across quarters?** No. Points reset to 0 when each quarter ends, after the evaluation, so every qualifying quarter starts from 0.
